night_note: Night. Drink loosens tongues at the tavern; the river, bridge, woods and mill can be watched. Two late nights a week at most.
night_done: No more going out tonight. Back to the office and bed.
day_note: The number on a sign is how many people are there now; ★ marks a lead. Walking in is free; talking or the records cost an action.
warn_nights: You've had two late nights this week already. Another, and you'll sleep through tomorrow morning.
tavern_note: A late night; tomorrow goes on as usual.
tavern_listen: Sit inside and listen (plenty to hear, little of it reliable, some of it false)
tavern_watch: Wait outside and watch who comes and goes
watch_confirm: Keep watch at {place} all night? What you see yourself is the surest thing there is, but there may be nothing to see.
